title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Are you an experienced Accounts Assistant or Purchase Ledger professional looking for a new hybrid opportunity for a global business with an excellent people driven culture?

Our client is looking for an organised and detail-focused Accounts Assistant to join their Finance team. You'll take responsibility for a varied range of Purchase Ledger activities, working closely with suppliers and colleagues across the business.

Key Responsibilities:
- Processing purchase invoices and credit notes
- Maintaining supplier accounts and keeping payment details and terms up to date
- Handling supplier queries and resolving invoice, payment and statement discrepancies
- Preparing supplier payment runs and ensuring payments are correctly authorised
- Completing supplier statement reconciliations and investigating outstanding items
- Processing company credit card transactions and employee expenses
- Supporting month end activities, including reconciliations, journals and accruals
- Assisting with audit requirements and maintaining accurate Purchase Ledger records

Who They're Looking For:
- Previous experience in Purchase Ledger or a similar finance role
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
- Good organisational skills and the ability to meet deadlines
- Confident communication skills when dealing with suppliers and internal teams
- Good problem-solving skills, particularly around invoices, payments and reconciliations
- Experience using ERP system is desirable

What's On Offer:
- Hybrid working arrangement
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Private medical cover
- Life Assurance
- Enhanced pension with employer contributions increasing with service
- Enhanced maternity and paternity pay
- Access to learning opportunities and study leave

If you have a sharp eye for detail, enjoy keeping financial records accurate and like the satisfaction of knowing everything is in the right place, we would love to hear from you. Apply now.

title: Accounts Payable Assistant - Hybrid
description:
Sheridan Maine is working with a well-established and growing business in Bournemouth to recruit an experienced Accounts Payable Assistant to join its friendly and supportive finance team.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a successful, values-driven organisation with a portfolio of well-known consumer brands and an excellent reputation for its positive working culture.
The role offers a varied workload, hybrid working and an attractive benefits package, making it an excellent opportunity for someone with previous purchase ledger experience who enjoys being part of a collaborative finance team.

The Role
Reporting into the finance team, you will take responsibility for the day-to-day running of the purchase ledger, ensuring invoices, payments and expenses are processed accurately and efficiently.
Key responsibilities will include:
- Processing purchase invoices and credit notes, ensuring accurate coding and posting to the accounting system.
- Maintaining supplier accounts and ensuring records are accurate and up to date.
- Preparing and processing supplier payment runs in line with agreed payment terms.
- Reconciling supplier statements and investigating any discrepancies.
- Handling supplier queries relating to invoices, payments and account balances.
- Processing employee expenses and company credit card transactions.
- Assisting with month-end activities, including reconciliations, journals and accruals.
- Supporting audit requirements and identifying opportunities to improve existing processes.

About You
The successful candidate will have previous experience working in an Accounts Payable or Purchase Ledger role and will be confident managing a busy workload while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
You will ideally have:
- Previous experience in an Accounts Payable / Purchase Ledger position.
- Good knowledge of invoice processing, supplier reconciliations and payment runs.
- Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills.
- Confident communication skills and the ability to build positive relationships with suppliers and colleagues.
- A proactive approach to resolving queries and meeting deadlines.

In addition to hybrid working, the business offers an excellent range of benefits.

If you're an experienced Purchase Ledger Assistant looking for your next opportunity in Bournemouth, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today or contact Sheridan Maine for further information.

Apply today or contact Mandy Marsh for a confidential discussion.

title: Bookkeeper

title: Bureau Payroll Officer
description:
Bureau Payroll Officer - Poole - £30,000

Payroll is a role where accuracy, organisation and attention to detail really matter. If you're someone who enjoys solving problems, managing deadlines and building strong relationships with clients, this could be an excellent opportunity.

Trial Balance are delighted to be working with a well-respected accountancy practice in their search for an experienced Bureau Payroll Officer to join their Poole office.

Working with a varied portfolio of business clients, you'll take ownership of payroll processing, handle day-to-day queries and ensure each client receives a reliable, professional and timely service.

As Bureau Payroll Officer, your responsibilities will include:
- Processing payrolls for a portfolio of approximately 30-50 clients, ensuring all calculations are accurate and deadlines are met
- Checking payroll information and handling employee data
- Calculating statutory payments, including maternity pay, sick pay and holiday pay
- Liaising directly with clients to obtain payroll information, resolve queries and investigate discrepancies
- Maintaining accurate payroll records and ensuring all processing is completed within agreed timescales
- Keeping up to date with payroll legislation and applying relevant changes correctly
- Working collaboratively with colleagues across different departments.

The successful Bureau Payroll Officer will bring:

Previous hands-on payroll experience, ideally gained within a payroll bureau or accountancy practice, with the confidence to manage a portfolio of client payrolls independently.

You'll be highly organised, methodical and detail-focused, with the ability to manage competing deadlines in a busy environment. Strong communication skills and a professional, client-focused approach will be essential.

The role is initially office-based during probation with the option of hybrid working then becoming an option.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Bureau Payroll Officer looking for a varied role where they can take responsibility for their work, build lasting client relationships and continue developing their payroll expertise.

For further information, please apply quoting reference JVS11345, or contact Jay Vilarrubi-Smith for a confidential conversation.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller

Location: Office-Based
Job Type: Permanent

Are you an experienced Credit Controller looking for your next opportunity? We are seeking a proactive and organised individual to join a busy finance team, where you'll play a key role in managing customer accounts, improving cash flow, and maintaining strong client relationships.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys building rapport with customers, resolving account queries, and working in a fast-paced finance environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Act as the main point of contact for customer account and payment queries.
- Proactively manage customer accounts to ensure timely collection of outstanding invoices.
- Review new and existing customer accounts, assessing creditworthiness and recommending appropriate credit limits and payment terms.
- Carry out account reconciliations and manage customer portals, including EDI integrations.
- Investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies and payment issues efficiently.
- Produce and distribute customer statements, overdue notices, and reminder communications.
- Monitor credit exposure and take action to minimise risk and reduce bad debt.
- Prepare and circulate regular reports on credit holds, account statuses, and debtor performance.
- Build and maintain strong working relationships with both customers and internal stakeholders.
- Support month-end processes, including preparation of consolidated invoices.
- Escalate significant issues and concerns where appropriate.

About You
- Previous experience within Credit Control, Accounts Receivable, or a similar finance role.
- Strong understanding of credit management principles and debt collection processes.
- Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
- Confident handling customer queries and resolving issues professionally.
- Strong attention to detail with excellent organisational skills.
- Experience with account reconciliations and financial systems.
- Comfortable working independently while contributing positively to a team environment.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

What's on Offer?
- Permanent, full-time position.
- Friendly and supportive team environment.
- Opportunity to make a real impact within a growing finance function.
- Varied role with a mix of customer interaction, account management, and financial administration responsibilities.

If you're a motivated Credit Controller who enjoys building relationships, improving cash flow, and delivering excellent customer service, we'd love to hear from you.

description:

- Previous hands-on payroll experience, ideally managing your own client portfolio.
